task: Regression: predicted O-level mathematics score (0-100); flag students predicted below a cut-off

excluded.bag_color: synthetic noise - duplicate records of the same student differ only in bag colour

cutoff_basis: Maximises F2 (recall weighted 2x) on out-of-fold training predictions
selection_rule: Lowest mean CV RMSE; models within 1% are tied and the tie is broken by out-of-fold F2 for flagging weak students
intended_use: Identify students likely to score below a credit pass so they can be offered support early.
limitations: Predictions are estimates with a typical error of a few marks; use them to prioritise support, not to label students.
Trained on one school's cohort; re-validate before using elsewhere.
Some attributes (e.g. gender) are used as predictors; review fairness before deployment.
